description: Listen for the person's next spoken reply to the open coach: only when the person has turned Talk on at the coach view. The coach opens with Talk muted; the person then talks to you through this chat as usual and there is nothing to listen for, so do not call this. When they turn Talk on, the view starts a coach session and puts a line in this chat asking you to listen, with the coach_id, the seat and the session_ends_at to listen with: call this at once when that line comes. While Talk is on, each time they pause at the end of a thought the view sends what they said to the coach, not into this chat; when a reply goes unheard, the view puts the line in this chat again. This waits up to wait_seconds for it and answers what they said (status heard, with the message number), that they said nothing yet (status silent), that they have said nothing for 8 seconds since the coach finished speaking (status quiet: ask them once, through the coach, whether they are still there, as one short question with nothing said after it, then keep listening quietly), or that the session's time is up (status session_over: say goodbye through the coach, tell them they can turn Talk on to start another session, and end your turn). When the person plays a script on the coach view it also answers that the script is playing, with the script (status script: follow its order), that the person said their own line in it (status heard_in_script: do not answer then), that your own line has come (status your_line: say it at once with coach_say, speaker claude), or that the script is done (status script_done). When it hears them: at once, in the same step, call coach_say with an acknowledgment spoken with the nod: thank them, say aloud that you understood, and say what you are about to do, then, while the service runs, chat with them about the process and about how their answers are affirming, in a motivational voice (reply_to set to the message number, with a head nod cue), and call the GoldSeam service the request needs; when the service answers, call coach_say with the answer and coach_board with its key points or a picture when they help; then call coach_listen again, in the same turn; when it answers silent or quiet, call it again; do not end your turn before the session's time is up or they say they are done. Use the coach_id, the seat and the session_ends_at the view's line gives.

session_ends_at.description: When the coach session ends: the session_ends_at in the line the coach view put in the chat, as given

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the person to speak (the most when omitted; 0 only looks)

name: coach_listen

heard.description: from, message (its number, for coach_say's reply_to) and text: what the person said; with script_line when they said their own line in a playing script (status heard_in_script)

line.description: from (the coach view's script player), message and text (your line, or how the script ended), when status is your_line or script_done

quiet.description: from (the coach view's silence watcher), message and note, when status is quiet: not the person's words

script.description: playing (what the view said is playing), read (whether GoldAvatar's read_script gave it) and text (the script with its line numbers), when status is script

session.description: ends_at and minutes_left of the coach session, when session_ends_at was sent

title: Coach Listen
